about_the_game:
Survive as Quinn, a Dark Matter harvester on the hostile planet Viridan in this challenging solo extraction shooter.

**Harvest, Shoot, Survive & Escape.**

## About This Game

Step into the boots of Quinn, a corporate harvester working for Dame Corporation's unofficial Dark Matter extraction division. Set in the year 2185 on the lush jungle planet Viridan, this challenging third-person extraction shooter puts your survival skills to the ultimate test.

The year is 2135. The discovery of harvestable Dark Matter on planet Viridan triggered a devastating 50-year interstellar war that ended humanity's oil age. To restore peace, humans delegated Dark Matter exploitation to The Guardians—an autonomous robot faction tasked with securing the galaxy's energy supply.

But some corporations found a way around the rules...

Key Features

- **Solo Extraction Gameplay**: Every mission is a high-stakes operation. Venture into Viridan's dangerous jungles to harvest valuable Dark Matter, but can you extract alive?

- **Lush Jungle Planet**: Explore diverse biomes across the verdant world of Viridan, where deadly Guardian robots patrol ancient jungle ruins and rival guild mercenaries compete for the same precious resources

- **Play as Quinn**: Experience the story of a corporate harvester caught in Dame Corporation's shadow operations, risking everything in the illegal Dark Matter trade

- **Challenging Combat**: Face off against The Guardians' advanced AI and rival harvesters in tactical third-person shooter combat that rewards strategy and stealth

- **Powered by Unreal Engine 5**: Stunning visuals bring Viridan's diverse jungle biomes to life with breathtaking detail

Are you (really) ready ?

In this corporate espionage thriller, every extraction is a gamble against The Guardians' surveillance and rival guild operations. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth behind Dame Corporation's illegal mining operations?

Can you harvest enough Dark Matter before The Guardians discover your presence?

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
